title: A project's own git hook wiring is lost on every fresh clone, silently, and no layer of the stack owns it
body:
Split out of 0035's instance 2 by hv's ruling of 2026-09-16: `precommit` runs a project's pre-commit gate and never wires a git hook, so this gap is not that command's, and until now it had no owner anywhere in the stack.

**The defect.** `.git/hooks/` is untracked in every git repository by construction. A project that wires its own guards into `.git/hooks/pre-commit` by hand loses that wiring on every fresh clone, and nothing prints to say so. The clone still inherits the guards Intent's keg installs, so a commit there is gated -- just by fewer guards than the project's own checkout -- and the difference cannot be seen from the clone.

**Measured at Lamplight (reported 2026-08-28).** Four project guards were hand-wired through `.git/hooks/pre-commit`. Their bodies are tracked in `bin/hooks/`, so only the wiring is lost on a clone -- which makes the loss quieter, not smaller. One guard, `whiteboard-inbox-guard`, vanishes outright.

**Reach.** Every consumer that hand-wires hooks has this, so it is fleet-wide and not Lamplight's alone.

**Not ruled: the shape.** Candidates, for whoever picks it up:

- `git config core.hooksPath` pointing at a tracked directory. This is per-clone config too, so something still has to set it.
- `doctor` compares the hooks that should be wired, taken from a tracked declaration, with what `.git/hooks` actually runs, and reports the difference. It is a detector, not a fixer, and it fits D11's "deactivation must be visible".
- Intent's hook carrier owns project guards as well as its own. That is Intent's decision, and would be filed there.

The first thing to settle is which layer owns hook wiring at all: devbin, Intent, or the project.


---

## Routed 2026-09-16 -- hv: Intent owns hook wiring

hv chose among three options: Intent owns it, a devbin `doctor` detector, or devbin wiring `core.hooksPath` at install. hv took **Intent owns it**, on vc's recommendation. Intent already writes `.git/hooks` in every estate (`pre-commit.intent`) and runs its own guards from there, so a project's guards belong on the same carrier and not on a second one devbin would add.

Filed at Intent as **intent#0426** (Intent `d74121952`, with its view at `140d209c1`). devbin has nothing to build: `precommit` runs a gate and never wires a hook (0035). Closed here as routed.
